name: field-drain-source-capability-gate-20260717
goal: Add a deterministic, project-isolated intake gate that blocks drain geometry when a project has no drain source or when its source explicitly requires field resolution, while allowing only same-project, digest-bound, source-resolved geometry to proceed.
exit_criteria: Building J is blocked with a specific no-project-drain-evidence issue and cannot receive any drain geometry.
New Hope preserves its two field-resolution-required drain intents and cannot promote them into an exact route.
A candidate route from another project is rejected even when its geometry is otherwise well formed.
A future source-resolved route requires same-project identity, a source digest present in the receipt, and finite source-bound segments.
verification_gates: focused happy-path and adversarial unit tests
existing New Hope and Building J regression tests
formal prover check or exact unavailable receipt
